stories.headline: WORLD OF HORROR gets its largest free update, AS BELOW SO ABOVE
stories.summary: The 1.2 update is now available on PC via Steam, GOG and itch.io. Publisher Ysbryd Games says it expands the cosmic-horror RPG by roughly 20%, with new Old Gods, three playable characters, additional mysteries and a Scenario Mode. Expanded modding tools add more replay possibilities, making this a substantial free return for existing PC players.

stories.headline: Cronos: Lazarus DLC confirmed for December 3 on PC
stories.summary: Bloober Team has dated its survival-horror expansion for December 3, 2026. The prequel follows the Pathfinder on the road to becoming the Warden, with more aggressive combat and a relentless pursuer called the Tracker. It is a substantial new story chapter for Cronos: The New Dawn owners and already has a verified Steam DLC page.

stories.headline: The Wolf Among Us Remastered arrives on PC with Noir Mode
stories.summary: Telltale's remaster launched on Steam on October 29, restoring all five episodes with enhanced visuals, a black-and-white Noir Mode, playable deleted scenes and behind-the-scenes extras. A 20% Steam launch offer runs through November 12, while eligible owners of the original qualify for a larger 50% discount. It is a timely entry point to Bigby Wolf's detective story.

stories.headline: Goblin Cleanup opens a pirate dungeon and launches new Twitch Drops
stories.summary: The Pirate Bay update adds the first two Black Bay dungeon levels to the co-op cleaning sim, alongside firing cannons, new traps, cosmetics, leaderboards and accessibility options. A new six-item Twitch Drops campaign began October 30 and runs through November 25. It is the game's first new dungeon since entering Steam Early Access.

stories.headline: 1992 PC-98 horror adventure Dead of the Brain returns on Steam
stories.summary: The Japanese point-and-click zombie horror game originally released in 1992 is now available on modern PCs through Steam. Publisher FAKKU's rerelease retains the pixel-art presentation and combines investigation, visual-novel storytelling and quick-time events, with optional quality-of-life aids and a demo. It preserves a cult PC horror title for a new audience.

stories.headline: Fatal Claw adds free difficulty options, Speedrun Mode and 10 skills
stories.summary: NDEV GAMES has released a free content update for its 2D Metroidvania, introducing Explorer, Warrior and Trial difficulties, configurable adventure settings, ten Fusion Skills, Speedrun Mode and a new outfit. Boss balancing and progression improvements make the update especially useful for both newcomers and returning players.
